prompt:
Create a finished, polished Chinese social-media advertising poster for the Windows desktop companion 屏幕良伴 ScreenKeeper. It cares about people who spend long hours at computers and use multiple displays, through break reminders, per-screen privacy curtains, and idle-screen rest. Use sophisticated lifestyle editorial photography with subtle illustrative treatment, warm cream (#F4F1E7), deep forest green (#153B30), mist sage (#A9C4AA), soft daylight, very subtle paper grain, crisp huge modern Chinese sans-serif typography. This is a believable warm home-office scene, not cyberpunk, not a SaaS dashboard, no generic shield or heart clipart. The product's visual motif is a tranquil misty evergreen mountain forest on one monitor. No claims of medical benefits, no health scores, no fake user statistics, no pricing claims, no official platform logo. Screens show only fictional abstract document layouts or a full opaque forest privacy image; no private information, no Apple hardware/logo, and no invented elaborate product UI. All exact text below must be spelled correctly in Simplified Chinese. Keep text inside generous safe margins. The result must be ONE full finished poster, not a contact sheet or mockup of a poster on a wall.
FORMAT: horizontal 16:9, high resolution, preferably 1536x864 or 2048x1152.
COMPOSITION: left 52% cream negative space with enormous forest-green headline and small brand line; right 48% beautiful sunlit oak double-monitor desk, green desk lamp, ceramic cup. One screen is a generic active work document, the other a peaceful opaque forest scene. At far right a natural partial view of an adult office worker gently stretching away from the keyboard, relaxed. Desk and scene softly blend into the cream left field, refined editorial ad. The headline must dominate and be readable as a thumbnail.

small top line: "屏幕良伴 ScreenKeeper"
huge headline on two lines: "工作有人催" / "休息有人提醒"
support line: "给久坐、多屏办公的你，一个体贴的桌面搭子"
bottom feature line: "隐私保护 · 休息提醒 · 闲屏休息"
small bottom footer: "Windows 便携版｜完整解压即可使用"
tiny scene label in bottom-right: "场景示意"
Make this feel like a caring useful desktop companion, emotionally appealing, commercially art-directed, not a clinical wellness ad.
